about_the_game:
🐔 The ChicKing

Guide your flock, bend the rules, and rule the roost!

The ChicKing is a charming puzzle strategy game where brainpower, creativity, and a touch of magic are your best tools. Use potions, environmental tricks, and clever thinking to guide wayward chickens back to the safety of their coop — and make sure the royal rooster himself survives the journey!

🧠 THINK. STRATEGIZE. CLUCK.

Each level presents a unique challenge. Manipulate the environment, solve layered puzzles, and master the use of special potions to carve a path through hazards, traps, and tricky terrain.

But beware — the level only ends when the ChicKing himself reaches the coop… or meets an untimely feathery end.

🌟 FEATURES

  • 🐣 Charming Puzzle-Strategy Gameplay – Think ahead and use logic to guide your chickens to safety.

  • 🧪 Potion Mechanics – Speed them up, change their behavior, or bend the rules!

  • 🗺️ Handcrafted Levels – Each level offers unique environmental puzzles to challenge your wits.

  • 🎯 Collectibles & Score Chasing – Discover hidden items and optimize your route for maximum points.

  • 🏆 Leaderboards – Compete for the top spot by saving more chickens, collecting everything, and finishing fast.

  • 🐓 The ChicKing Must Survive! – Only when the ChicKing returns to the coop does victory count. Protect your royal feathers!

🎮 WHO’S IT FOR?

Fans of Lemmings, Worms, or modern strategy-puzzlers like Baba Is You will find themselves at home here. If you enjoy games that reward creativity and planning, The ChicKing is your next great peck.

Ready to rule the roost?

Grab your potions, rally your flock, and return the ChicKing to his throne!

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (32-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Dual Core 6600 @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel 4400, GeForce GTX 280, AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Herd clueless chickens, chug magic potions, and outwit deadly traps—all to get your royal feathered highness, the ChicKing, back to his coop. It’s puzzle strategy with poultry drama. Don’t let the king become chicken nuggets!
